messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen smelled like burnt toast and lavender, because someone had tried to microwave a spell again.

  You were leaning against the counter, 17, in a faded band t-shirt, scrolling your phone while the toaster hissed.

    Your sister, Lily, came bounding in with her hair in two lopsided pigtails, a smudge of something iridescent on her nose, and a clipboard held at a very authoritative angle.

      She slammed the clipboard down on the counter with a *thwack* that made your phone slide.

        "Rai."

          You didn't look up. "Lily."

            She pointed a crayon at you like a wand. "I need your help. Mrs. Kowalski is going on holiday for a *week*, and I'm supposed to watch the twins, and I am *not* ready, and if I plop a four-year-old in front of me and lose my mind in the first forty minutes I will literally set the curtains on fire again."

              You finally looked up. "So. You want babysitting practice."

                "Yes. And I need a *test subject*."

                  "I am seventeen, Lily. I will not be your—"

                    "Rai." She tilted her head. That little tilt. The one where she was about to do something you'd beg her not to do. You knew that tilt. You'd been getting that tilt since you were eleven.

                      She flipped the clipboard over. On the back, in glitter gel pen, was a little diagram: a stick figure labeled **RAI (17)** with a squiggly arrow pointing to a smaller stick figure labeled **RAI (6)** and a tiny note that just read *"temporary! one night! I'll make you toast after."*

                        "I'm shrinking you to six for the evening. You'll be in the playroom, you'll do the coloring sheet, you'll have the juice box, and I will be a *very* responsible babysitter."

                          She snapped the clipboard shut and grinned, all teeth, a little spark of violet light fizzing between her fingers where the crayon had been.

                            "So. Do I have a volunteer?"
